text:
maya: Final call for internal release note copy + evacuation lanes for tomorrow's canary. Need sign-off by 18:00 PT.

ben: Quick question on pinning: should hosted switch to v2.3.2-rc or hold on v2.3.1? Dedicated customers need a stable window.

maya: Hosted -> v2.3.2-rc (canary only). Dedicated remains v2.3.0 until we confirm memory regression is gone.

rachel: Draft RN blurb (internal): "Canary deploy: model service v2.3.2-rc (hosted). This release reduces KV cache misses and improves tail latency for long-context requests. Expected token throughput +8%. Canary starts 22:45 UTC. If any latency or quality regressions are observed, we'll revert hosted to v2.3.1."

jorge: Rollback trigger thresholds I propose: p95 latency increase > 20% sustained for 10m OR error rate > 2% for 3m. If triggered we run the scripted rollback and open #incidents.

jorge: ```
# quick rollback
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/rollbacks -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROLL_KEY' -d 'release=v2.3.2-rc&target=v2.3.1'
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/hosted-runtime --to-revision=42
```

ops-oncall: I'll be on pager from 22:30-01:00 UTC. Please add me to the watch rotation and ping me if the auto-alert fires.

ben: I added ops-oncall + rachel to the watchlist. Also flipping a canary knob: `BATCH_MAX=6` and `KV_PREFETCH=true` to reduce regen and exercise the cache path.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued: canary -> hosted-cluster-b; release=v2.3.2-rc; scheduled=2025-02-10T22:45Z. react :white_check_mark: to approve.

maya: Two small RN edits: change "Expected token throughput +8%" -> "Typical throughput uplift ~+5-10% depending on seq length" and add note about customer-facing docs: "no public downtime".

rachel: Updated. Also adding evacuation lane: if we need fast rollback and CNAME swap, run `scripts/evacuate.sh --instant` from ops runbook.

ben: Can we have a quick smoke test set up? I'll post the test prompts here by 22:10 UTC.

maya: Perfect. Last ask: capture a few golden prompts (long context + embeddings) and post perf snapshots. If no objections, we'll flip the deploy at 22:45.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] deploy started: canary -> hosted-cluster-b (2 nodes). live logs: https://logs.internal/deploys/1746667777

ops-oncall: Monitoring now. I'll paste any anomalies in this thread and escalate to infra-leads if thresholds hit.

rachel: Final copy for internal blast: "Rolling out hosted canary v2.3.2-rc tonight at 22:45 UTC. Target uplift on throughput and tail latency; no expected public downtime. Watch p95/p50 and error rate; rollback criteria in thread. Ops oncall monitoring."

maya: Thanks everyone. If you add test outputs, drop them here before 22:10 UTC or we hold the deploy. :thumbsup:
